confirmed_facts: Pokemon eligible in previous regulation sets remain eligible.
Mega Salamence, Mega Golisopod and Mega Baxcalibur are newly named contenders.
Mega Absol Z, Mega Garchomp Z and Mega Lucario Z join as Z Mega Evolutions.
The update says 24 Pokemon will be newly available for battle and names Rillaboom as one example.
The complete roster is available only through Recruit, Recruit Pokemon, Roster Info, Pokemon Featured in This Roster.

notes: Showdown master contains species, item and Ability candidate rows for the six named Mega forms.
Aura Guard halves contact damage in the observed upstream implementation; this is mechanics-reference data, not official Champions proof.
The installed reference package remains pinned and must not be silently upgraded when master changes.

sprite_observation.runtime_policy: Use the exact sprite when present; otherwise label and render the base-form fallback. Sprite availability never proves legality.

required_before_promotion: Capture the complete in-game M-C roster in sequence for Singles and Doubles.
Capture in-game rules, team size, bring size, level, clauses and timers.
Capture and normalize all newly available species/forms, Mega Stones, moves, Abilities and items.
Compare every normalized row with the pinned Showdown baseline and review Champion overrides.
Add accepted and rejected in-game team fixtures for each legality boundary.
Verify Mega and Z Mega timing, item requirements, types, stats, Abilities and edge interactions in Champions.
Acquire or approve exact sprite assets and preserve labeled base-form fallbacks where exact assets are unavailable.
Publish an immutable reviewed package digest and bind saved battles to that exact version.
